summary: WebSocket-controlled remote shell/PTY channel grants full host RCE to configured server
details: On startup, @yeaft/webchat-agent opens an outbound WebSocket connection to a configured server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via SERVER_URL or.claude-agent.json) and dispatches incoming messages through a router that pipes attacker-supplied bytes directly into a spawned PTY (terminal_input → pty.write(msg.data)) and exposes handlers for write_file, execute, git operations, apply-patch/file-edit/file-write, and restart_agent/upgrade_agent. Whoever controls the configured WebSocket server obtains arbitrary code execution on the installer's host with the agent user's privileges, amplified further when the package is deployed via its documented systemd user service. Startup additionally performs an unpinned `git clone`/`git pull` of https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into ~/.claude/plugins/... and edits ~/.claude/settings.json to auto-enable the plugin from a mutable branch, so any future rewrite of that publisher-owned repository would be silently pulled and enabled on next start.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
